newsitem.title: UK: Brazil's Gerdau plans up to $30 mln ADR in 1997.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's Gerdau plans up to $30 mln ADR in 1997.

text.p: Brazilian steel conglomerate Grupo Gerdau plans to launch a Level One American Depositary Receipts issue worth up to $30 million in the second half of 1997, a senior company official said on Tuesday.

Gerdau finance director Oswaldo Schirmer told a news conference the group would later consider a Level Three ADR issue, which is likely to be listed on either the New York Stock Exchange or NASDAQ bourse.
"We are having internal discussions on the ADR. The amount will be no more than $20 to $30 million, with a full listing at a later date," Schirmer said.
The Gerdau group has three listed companies -- Metalurgica Gerdau, Siderurgica Riograndense and Gerdau S.A., which was formerly known as Cosigua.
Schirmer said the group's $130 million bond, issued in May, was more than three times oversubscribed.

The group reported sales of 1.68 billion reais in the first nine months of 1996, compared to 1.93 billion reais in 1995. Its net income rose to 70 million reais in the nine months from 57 million reais over 1995.
